HostedPage.title: HostedPage
HostedPage.description: Information about a hosted website or mock API on PageHost

title.description: Title of the hosted website or mock API

description.description: Description of the website or API endpoint

password.description: Optional access password for private sites

views.description: Number of times the website or API has been loaded

updatedAt.description: Latest update timestamp of the deployment

rootFile.description: Entrypoint HTML file path, usually index.html

type.description: Distinction between an HTML page and a JSON Mock API

apiResponse.description: JSON raw content response for mock API

apiMethod.description: HTTP Method allowed for this mock API

envVariables.description: Custom environment variables or third-party API Keys injected into the hosted website

PageFile.title: PageFile
PageFile.description: A single static asset or file belonging to a hosted page

path.description: Relative file path inside the hosting sandbox

content.description: File text content or Base64 encoded data

/pages/{pageId}.description: Index collection of all hosted websites

/pages/{pageId}/files/{fileId}.description: Subcollection holding files and assets for each hosted page
